item.title: C++ Thread Safety, Reinventing The Wheel, and Making My Life Easier
item.description:
Alternative title: Carcinization? In my C++ codebase? It’s more likely than you think.

Whilst the job search continues, I thought I’d get out a quicker writeup about a lifesaver of a tool I’ve recently implemented in my ongoing project indy-tui1 and how I stumbled iterated my way to it.

Background#

By its nature, indy-tui requires keeping several threads up and running – when managing an interface, user input, and a live websocket session, one’s hand is slightly forced. Likewise, some amount of shared data across threads is largely unavoidable. Hence, it’s time for locking.
